title: Aspirin for Primary Prevention Reduces Cardiovascular Events, Increases Bleeding Risk

sections.abstract: <jats:p> <jats:bold>According to this study:</jats:bold> </jats:p> <jats:p> <jats:list list-type="bullet"><jats:list-item><jats:p>In people with no history of cardiovascular disease, aspirin is associated with a reduced risk of cardiovascular events but an increased risk of major bleeding.</jats:p></jats:list-item></jats:list> </jats:p>
